title: Darwin's dog that inherited a fear of butchers

tellings.quote: the case that Darwin was reported in a paper in nature was a dog that belonged to someone he knew that got very frightened whenever it went past a butcher's shop

plain: A biologist named Rupert Sheldrake, on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, recalls a case that Charles Darwin, the naturalist, reported in a paper in the science journal Nature. It was about a dog belonging to someone Darwin knew, which got very frightened whenever it walked past a butcher's shop. Sheldrake tells it as an example of a fear that may be inherited, which would mean memories can somehow pass down through generations.
